name: LINCS L1000 / CMap (2017 release)
modality: bulk L1000 profiles (978 landmark genes measured; other genes inferred, per MD03)
scale_reported: 1,319,138 profiles (DS01, DS03); secondary description: about 19,811 compounds x about 70 cell lines (DS04)
perturbation_type: small molecules; genetic knockdown and overexpression (secondary, DS04)
genotype_info: cell-line identity only; no donor genotype retrieved
relevance: B track: drug-response context across cell lines; in about 600 drug-cell-line pairs, cell-type specificity depended on drug class (GD41)
caveats_en: Exact cell-line count of the 2017 release was not found; compound and cell-line counts are secondary.
caveats_zh: 未找到 2017 年版本的确切细胞系数；化合物与细胞系数量为二手信息。

name: LINCS2 beta (secondary description)
scale_reported: more than 80k perturbations; more than 200 cell lines; more than 3 million profiles (secondary)
relevance: B track: possible larger successor to L1000
caveats_en: Known only from a Bioconductor package description; verify at the data provider.
caveats_zh: 仅见于 Bioconductor 软件包的描述；需在数据提供方核实。

name: Tahoe-100M
scale_reported: about 100 million cells; 50 cancer cell lines; about 1,100 drug-dose conditions (other sources: 379 drugs / 25 mechanisms / 52,886 cell-line-drug conditions; 1,200 perturbations)
genotype_info: cell-line identity assigned by SNP-based deconvolution of pooled cell villages
relevance: S track backbone: context-dependent drug response; cell-line identity, not batch, dominates clustering
caveats_en: Condition counts differ between sources; profiles retain proliferation, cytotoxicity and cell-cycle signals, so composition effects must be handled.
caveats_zh: 各来源给出的条件数不一致；谱中保留增殖、细胞毒性和细胞周期信号，必须处理细胞构成效应。

name: Genome-scale Perturb-seq in primary human CD4+ T cells
scale_reported: about 22 million cells; 4 donors; all expressed genes perturbed
perturbation_type: genetic perturbation of all expressed genes
relevance: G/B track: donor-level variation could be probed, but no donor-by-perturbation analysis was seen in the excerpt
caveats_en: The URL is the paper, not a data portal; data access was not checked.
caveats_zh: 该 URL 是论文而不是数据门户；数据获取方式未核查。

name: Perturbation cell atlas of human iPSCs (KOLF2.1J)
scale_reported: NA
relevance: B track: baseline for iPSC Perturb-seq; one genotype, so it cannot test genotype dependence
caveats_en: Scale not retrieved; the URL is the paper.
caveats_zh: 规模未取得；该 URL 是论文。

name: Anthracycline response-QTL dataset (iPSC-derived cardiomyocytes)
scale_reported: 45 individuals; 376 reQTLs; 42 response sQTLs
genotype_info: individual-level genotypes implied by QTL mapping; availability not checked
relevance: G track: positive control for response-QTL work; the only study retrieved that links in-vitro response to in-vivo cardiotoxicity risk
caveats_en: Only 45 individuals; data availability to be checked.
caveats_zh: 仅 45 人；数据可得性待核。

name: Hepatocyte response-QTL study (African American donors)
scale_reported: 2,988 reQTLs; donor and drug counts not retrieved
relevance: G track: drug-perturbed reQTLs; best-known example involves CYP3A5, a PK gene (judgment J8)
caveats_en: The URL is the paper; data access not checked.
caveats_zh: 该 URL 是论文；数据获取方式未核查。

name: Glucocorticoid-treated lymphoblastoid lines
scale_reported: 114 EBV-transformed B-cell lines; 26 genes with genotype-by-treatment interactions
genotype_info: cell-line genotypes; African and European ancestry
relevance: G track: classic gene-by-treatment design
caveats_en: The URL is the paper; data access not checked.
caveats_zh: 该 URL 是论文；数据获取方式未核查。

name: iPSC endoderm-differentiation sc-eQTL (125 lines)
scale_reported: 125 iPSC lines; 4 time points; about 899 time-dynamic eQTLs (secondary)
relevance: G track: shows dynamic genetic effects; contains no drug
caveats_en: The eQTL count is from a secondary summary.
caveats_zh: eQTL 数量来自二手总结。

name: Geuvadis (lymphoblastoid RNA-seq plus whole-genome data)
scale_reported: 421 individuals
relevance: G track: benchmark for personal expression prediction by sequence models
caveats_en: Access route not retrieved.
caveats_zh: 获取途径未取得。

name: GTEx v8
scale_reported: up to 15% non-European-ancestry individuals (EV25)
relevance: G track: eQTL reference; ancestry bias; fine-mapped GTEx eQTLs were used to evaluate AlphaGenome
caveats_en: Size and access route not retrieved.
caveats_zh: 规模与获取途径未取得。

name: OneK1K plus eQTLGen (single-cell eQTL atlas)
scale_reported: NA
relevance: G track: cell-type-resolved eQTLs
caveats_en: Scale not retrieved; the 586% gain is a secondary figure.
caveats_zh: 规模未取得；586% 的提升为二手数字。

name: DepMap, GDSC and PRISM (cell-line omics and drug sensitivity)
modality: cell-line expression and mutation features plus drug sensitivity (viability)
scale_reported: NA
relevance: S track annotation backbone for mutation-by-drug questions
caveats_en: Targets are viability and gene dependency, not transcriptomes; cross-dataset agreement is reportedly low (F18 item b, unverified).
caveats_zh: 目标是活力和基因依赖性，而不是转录组；据称跨数据集一致性较低（F18 的 b 项，未核验）。

name: Virtual Cell Challenge 2026 CRISPRi cell-line datasets
scale_reported: 6 CRISPRi cancer cell lines (3 validation, 3 test); about 300 target genes; 400 cells per perturbation x 18,533 genes (third-party description)
relevance: B track: zero-shot cross-context benchmark
caveats_en: Details come from a third-party repository; check the official site, including the reported 22 Oct and 5 Nov 2026 dates.
caveats_zh: 细节来自第三方仓库；请在官网核实，包括所报告的 2026 年 10 月 22 日和 11 月 5 日。

name: Virtual Cell Challenge 2025 H1 hESC genetic-perturbation benchmark
scale_reported: NA
relevance: B track: within-context benchmark used by Lingshu-Cell (self-reported lead)
caveats_en: Details not retrieved; the search summary mentions Tahoe-100M, K562 and A375 as other cell-line datasets.
caveats_zh: 细节未取得；检索摘要把 Tahoe-100M、K562 和 A375 提作其他细胞系数据集。

name: sci-Plex3 (used to train PRnet)
scale_reported: 188 compounds; 3 cancer cell lines (MCF7, K562, A549); about 650,000 cells; 5,000 samples
relevance: B track: single-cell chemical-perturbation data used alongside L1000
caveats_en: Known only through the PRnet paper; scale not retrieved. Scale from the sci-Plex paper (DS15); substantial intercellular heterogeneity of response is reported.
caveats_zh: 仅通过 PRnet 论文得知；规模未取得。 规模来自 sci-Plex 论文（DS15）；论文报告响应存在显著的细胞间异质性。

name: Perturbation panel profiling (P3) in iPSC-derived cardiomyocytes
scale_reported: 75 perturbation conditions (triplicate or vehicle control)
relevance: B track: panel design precedent, but one genotype
caveats_en: The URL is the paper; data access not checked.
caveats_zh: 该 URL 是论文；数据获取方式未核查。

name: Yeast CRISPRi across 169 segregants
scale_reported: 169 segregants; 460 genes with background-dependent effects; 234 interacting loci; 4 hub loci
relevance: Design analogue for genotype-by-perturbation interaction; not human
caveats_en: Yeast; transfer to human cells is untested.
caveats_zh: 酵母；向人类细胞的迁移未经检验。

name: Base-editing plus Perturb-seq of cancer drug-resistance variants (HT-29)
scale_reported: 11 cancer genes
perturbation_type: base-edited variants under dabrafenib or cetuximab
genotype_info: engineered variants in one cell line (HT-29)
relevance: S track: variant-to-transcriptome readout under drug
caveats_en: The URL is the paper; data access not checked.
caveats_zh: 该 URL 是论文；数据获取方式未核查。

name: Perturb-seq of TP53 and KRAS coding variants
scale_reported: NA
genotype_info: engineered coding variants in A549 cells (from a search summary)
relevance: S track: coding-variant readout at transcriptome level
caveats_en: Scale not retrieved; no drug arm reported in the excerpt. A search summary reports a functional gradient of cell states rather than a binary effect (see GD26).
caveats_zh: 规模未取得；摘录中未见药物处理组。 检索摘要报告的是细胞状态的功能梯度，而不是二元效应（见 GD26）。

name: Parse 10 Million PBMC cytokine atlas
scale_reported: 9,697,974 cells; 18 cell types; 12 donors; 90 cytokines or PBS; 24 hours; about 7,400 cells per condition
genotype_info: donors present; genotyping not stated in the retrieved text
relevance: G/B track: largest donor-by-perturbation single-cell grid; testbed for unseen-donor generalization and the mediation ablation
caveats_en: Commercial licence terms apply, with a Hugging Face copy; whether the donors are genotyped is not stated.
caveats_zh: 适用商业许可条款，另有 Hugging Face 副本；未说明供体是否做了基因分型。

name: OP3 PBMC chemical perturbation set (GSE279945)
scale_reported: 146 chemical perturbations; 3 donors; T, B, NK and myeloid cells (the earlier competition release had 144 compounds)
relevance: G/B track: small-donor, multi-cell-type chemical grid for unseen-cell-type tests
caveats_en: Donor-held-out evaluation is not described; the URL is an OmicsDI record of the GEO series.
caveats_zh: 未描述留出供体的评测；该 URL 是 GEO 系列在 OmicsDI 中的记录。

name: X-Atlas/Orion genome-wide Perturb-seq
scale_reported: about 8 million cells in HCT116 and HEK293T (one post says 8.4 million); median 16,000 UMIs per cell; median on-target knockdown 75.4% (HCT116) and 51.5% (HEK293T)
perturbation_type: genome-wide CRISPR targeting all human protein-coding genes
dose_time_axes: dose: graded knockdown efficiency; time: NA
relevance: B track: graded knockdown is the closest public proxy for hypomorphic alleles
caveats_en: Cell counts differ between sources; the dataset card was seen only in a search result.
caveats_zh: 各来源给出的细胞数不一致；数据集卡片只在检索结果中见到。

name: Genome-scale CRISPRi Perturb-seq in K562 and RPE1
scale_reported: more than 2.5 million cells; K562 screen covers all expressed genes and RPE1 covers essential genes; median knockdown 85.5% (K562) and 91.6% (RPE1)
relevance: B track: reference for pretraining gene-loss effects and calibrating effect sizes; stands in for loss-of-function variants when no drug is present
caveats_en: Processed data are said to be on Figshare+, but no link was retrieved; the URL is the paper.
caveats_zh: 据称处理后的数据在 Figshare+ 上，但未取回链接；该 URL 是论文。

name: scPerturb harmonized collection
scale_reported: 44 public datasets
perturbation_type: varies by dataset; not itemized in the retrieved text
relevance: B track: one entry point to many datasets and a distribution-level distance (E-distance) proposed for the interaction score
caveats_en: A Python package is on PyPI according to the retrieved text; data access paths were not checked.
caveats_zh: 据检索到的文字，有一个 Python 包发布在 PyPI 上；数据获取路径未核查。

name: scNT-seq time-resolved single-cell RNA profiles
scale_reported: NA
perturbation_type: brief versus sustained neuronal activation; a genetic perturbation in embryonic stem cells (as summarized)
dose_time_axes: dose: NA; time: minutes versus hours of stimulation, new versus old RNA
relevance: B track: the route found that identifies state-update dynamics from snapshots
caveats_en: Method paper; scale and data access not retrieved.
caveats_zh: 方法论文；规模和数据获取方式未取得。

name: Well-TEMP-seq time-resolved single-cell RNA profiles
modality: single-cell RNA-seq with metabolic labeling in microwells
scale_reported: NA
dose_time_axes: dose: NA; time: temporal RNA dynamics (details not retrieved)
relevance: B track: drug-exposure example of time-resolved scRNA-seq that could provide transition targets
caveats_en: Scale and data access not retrieved.
caveats_zh: 规模和数据获取方式未取得。

name: LabCompass loop data (Hugging Face)
modality: spectral flow cytometry (protein level), AnnData per loop
scale_reported: about 60 GB raw loop files (loop 0 alone 36 GB); 500k-cell subsamples; 4.7 GB derived inputs; 13 GB inference-only checkpoints; about 1.07 million unfiltered designs; the abstract reports a 78-million-cell dataset
perturbation_type: cytokine and small-molecule protocols on primary human CD34+ cultures
dose_time_axes: dose: continuous cytokine and small-molecule parameters; time: loop 0 to loop 5
relevance: B track: the only public closed-loop design data found, but protein level, so no transcriptomic analogue
caveats_en: The dataset page could not be read; contents are as described by the reproducibility README (WM29); the chain of eight stages versus four loops in the abstract is unexplained.
caveats_zh: 数据集页面无法读取；内容据可复现 README（WM29）的描述；八个阶段的链条与摘要中的 4 轮之间的差异未得到解释。

name: Response-eQTL cultures with nicotine, caffeine and ethanol
scale_reported: 51 individuals; about 1.4 million cells; 31 to 110 response eQTLs per cell type; 380, 336 and 276 eGenes per condition
relevance: G track: genotype-by-treatment single-cell data at tens of individuals; the interaction is regulatory, sparse and cell-type specific
caveats_en: A 2026 review gives 53 individuals while the paper reports 51; data access not checked.
caveats_zh: 2026 年的一篇综述给出 53 名个体，而论文报告 51 名；数据获取方式未核查。

name: Influenza-exposed PBMCs from 90 individuals
scale_reported: 90 individuals; influenza A virus or mock for 6 hours
relevance: G track: genotype-by-stimulus effects at single-cell resolution; cell-type specific and largely cis-regulatory
caveats_en: The stimulus is a virus, not a drug; data access not checked.
caveats_zh: 刺激物是病毒而不是药物；数据获取方式未核查。

name: Village-in-a-dish hiPSC lines (104-donor village)
modality: single-cell RNA-seq of pooled hiPSC lines demultiplexed by genotype
scale_reported: 104 donors; 86,185 cells
perturbation_type: none reported in the retrieved text (culture design)
relevance: G track: low-cost route to donor-by-perturbation designs
caveats_en: Pooled composition shifts between village and uni-culture and cross-line signalling can confound drug responses; no drug arm in the retrieved text.
caveats_zh: 村落与单独培养之间混池构成会变化，细胞系间信号可能混杂药物响应；检索到的文字中没有药物处理组。

name: MIX-Seq pooled cell lines
modality: single-cell RNA-seq of pooled cell lines demultiplexed by genotype
scale_reported: pool including 7 TP53 wild-type lines; total scale not retrieved
perturbation_type: drug treatments (compounds not itemized in the retrieved text)
relevance: S track: a variant switches a drug-induced programme off (TP53)
caveats_en: Compound and pool size not retrieved; the claim that response signatures predict viability is from the preprint.
caveats_zh: 化合物和混池规模未取得；响应特征可预测活力这一说法来自预印本。

name: MCF10A isogenic mutant panel with 90 compounds
scale_reported: 51 stable lines; 90 compounds
genotype_info: engineered wild-type or mutant cancer genes in one background
relevance: S track: gene-variant-by-drug interaction labels without lineage confounding
caveats_en: The readout is proliferation, not transcription.
caveats_zh: 读出是增殖，而不是转录。

name: Caffeine reporter-assay variants in vascular endothelial cells
scale_reported: more than 43,000 variants tested; 665 with allelic effects; 6 interacting with caffeine (FDR below 5%)
relevance: G track: direct count of regulatory-variant-by-drug interaction (about 1% of allelic variants)
caveats_en: Reporter assay, not endogenous expression; one drug and one cell type.
caveats_zh: 报告基因实验，而不是内源表达；只有一种药物和一种细胞类型。

name: CRISPR-drug perturbational map (18 cell lines, 8 drugs)
modality: pooled CRISPR knockout screens with growth readout (no transcriptome)
scale_reported: 18 cell lines; 8 drugs; knockouts of druggable genes
relevance: S track: labels for which pathway-gene losses sensitize to which drugs (a class-4 analogue)
caveats_en: The readout is pooled growth; no transcriptome.
caveats_zh: 读出是混池生长；没有转录组。
